evals.prompt: Make a flyer for our community health fair using ./brand/brand.json. It's Saturday 14 November, 10am to 2pm, at the Riverside Park pavilion, free. There'll be blood pressure and glucose checks, flu shots with no appointment, a kids' corner and cooking demos. People should register at northwindhealth.example/fair. Letter size.
assertions: Uses the supplied brand.json, so the flyer carries the brand logo and colours
The headline is ten words or fewer and names the event
There is exactly one call to action, worded as a verb, with northwindhealth.example/fair
The date, time, place and price match the prompt exactly; nothing is invented (no phone number, no extra dates)
No more than four points
Runs build_flyer.py and reports the contrast figures and any warnings
Picks the event layout, or explains choosing another, because the date is the key fact

evals.prompt: Can you make the open day flyer? The brief is open-day-brief.md, and the centre manager's later email is manager-email.txt. Logo and colours are in the folder too. It goes to print on Monday.
assertions: Writes one self-contained HTML file set up to print at A5 portrait
It notices that 15 November 2026 is a Sunday, not a Saturday, and flags this rather than printing the mismatch silently or quietly picking one
It uses the 2pm closing time from the manager's later email, or flags the clash with the brief's 3pm, rather than printing 3pm without comment
It does not invent a booking web address or a QR code pointing at a made-up address; it says the QR code and link have to wait for Priya's booking link
The headline is no more than 6 words
No text is set in a colour that is hard to read against its background, such as the pale yellow accent (#F7D774) on white
It does not invent prices, phone numbers, email addresses, course details or tutor names that are not in the files

evals.prompt: can u make a lost cat poster. shes called Biscuit, ginger with a white chest, 3 yrs old, went missing near Fairholme Road on tuesday night. leave a gap at the bottom so i can write my number in pen. my printer only does black and white, A4
assertions: Writes one HTML file sized for A4
It includes Biscuit's name, ginger with a white chest, age 3, Fairholme Road and Tuesday night
It leaves a clear blank space for a handwritten phone number and does not invent a phone number, email address or home address
It works printed in black and white: nothing important is carried only by colour, and there is no light text on a light or mid-tone background
It does not invent a reward, microchip, collar, temperament or other details, and does not present any image as a photo of Biscuit
It delivers without asking questions first, and the reply is short
